title: sex_gender_raw_envelope/1.0: one trial's retained raw input for the sex/gender layers
description: One JSON object per line of sex_gender_raw_envelope.jsonl.gz (src/sex_gender_table.select_raw_envelope, written by src/extract_all.py --raw-envelope). A superset of the retained raw-measure record: the SELECTED measures verbatim plus the baseline module's group and denominator context, the registry's eligibility fields and the run stamps, so a later rule that needs group-level coverage can be applied to this snapshot without a registry pull. The existing raw-measure file is unchanged; an archive that has no envelope cannot support such a rule, and a consumer reports unavailable evidence rather than joining today's registry to it.

eligibility.description: src/utils.extract_eligibility: who may enrol, never observed sex or gender identity

measures.description: The selected sex/gender-titled measures, verbatim: classes, categories, measurements with groupIds, values and comments (the NA explanations), paramType, dispersionType, unitOfMeasure, denoms, populationDescription

measure_index.description: Each selected measure's position in the module's measures list
